As is traditional for BoCa LonGa, we will have a mixture of panels including standard conference panels with  short, presented research papers, focused panels with pre-circulated written papers, and "meet the projects" sessions for new work.

We will post a detailed schedule when we have one. For now, please plan for the conference to take the entire business day on Friday and Saturday, the 9th and 10th of April.
